actualBeta1Provider.limitation: Reproduces delayed snapshot readability, not the user's additional observation of a zero-byte file. This failed save did not establish a complete backup.

readbackFix.verification: Retry sequential reads of the exact already-written URI after READ failures or unequal content; require an exact match before proceeding.
readbackFix.pendingRead: Await the pending native read. The window bounds retries, not cancellation of an in-flight read; no overlapping read retries.
readbackFix.persistentFailure: Final unreadable content reports READ; final unequal content reports VERIFY. Later files are not created and existing snapshotSaved semantics remain intact.

finalCandidate.canonicalHtmlAndFourCsvComparison: PASSED for first cloud save and restored local re-export
finalCandidate.shorterCloudRewriteComparison: PASSED: exact current files, previous copy and preserved older snapshots

confirmedCleanupBug.before: A final history-cleanup listing failure rejected the save even after the snapshot, canonical JSON and all five readable companions had passed read-back verification.
confirmedCleanupBug.after: Cleanup failure retains extra history and does not invalidate the already verified save.
confirmedCleanupBug.regression: Inject a listing failure immediately after the final companion read-back; verify successful completion, exact current files, preservation of all 11 older archives and a restorable current backup.
confirmedCleanupBug.beforeResult: FAILED as expected: FolderBackupWriteError was returned where successful completion was required.
confirmedCleanupBug.relationshipToUserReport: Incidental confirmed bug. It does not establish the cause of the reported failure before a verified current snapshot.

streamOpenFailureRegression.result: PASSED before and after the cleanup fix
streamOpenFailureRegression.behavior: Creating a document and then failing to open its output stream leaves exactly one empty snapshot, reports FOLDER_SNAPSHOT_WRITE with snapshotSaved=false, and leaves no open handle.
streamOpenFailureRegression.restoreSafety: Both history and default restore reject the empty snapshot.
streamOpenFailureRegression.limitation: Synthetic failure injection demonstrates possible app behavior; it does not prove Dropbox failed to open a stream.

runOutputLocation: Execution transcript only; no standalone log file was saved.

review.faultInjectionIsolation: Faults exist only in test stubs. Stream-open failure is consumed before throwing; the temporary read override is restored in finally. Subsequent restore exercises confirm the one-shot listing fault was consumed.
review.productionScope: The final pruneSnapshots call gained a best-effort error boundary. Android SAF verification now retries reads of each once-written file within a bounded window. Writes and final verification still reject failures; backup pause safeguards are unchanged.
